title: Legal compliance example — obligation ledger (non-medical)
description: A minimal, non-medical module built on the same lgd-skeleton/1.0 contract as the 21 medical repositories. It turns a set of contract clauses into an obligation ledger: what must be done, by when, triggered by what, and who owns it. Included to show that the skeleton is industry-neutral — the contract is identical, only the domain content differs.
idea: Contract clause → obligation ledger with deadlines and owners
extension_note: Add an obligation type by extending OBLIGATION_TYPES; add an escalation rule in ESCALATION_RULES.
